quest.title: The Stress of Changing Careers
quest.description: At the northern training ground, you're suddenly stopped by a treasure hunter who seems very enthusiastic...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: D—Dear guests! I am Vaino! Might I borrow just one minute of your precious time? I swear you'll leave with a smile!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #This guy seems kinda weird... and Paimon heard him say "guinea pigs" just now. We should go, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Huh? Do I really come across as weird? Small wonder everyone keeps running off... But that's word-for-word the pitch that Boncza taught me back in Nasha Town...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If your goal is to blurt out a sales pitch, of course, it's going to come off sounding weird...

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Fair point. If someone ran up to me shouting, "Dear guests!" I'd probably avoid eye contact and hurry away too...

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: *sigh* Turns out starting a new career at my age isn't easy... Darn it, I really thought being a boss meant kicking back and letting the money roll in.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But hey, you did become a boss, right? Congratulations on that! But what made you want to change careers all of a sudden, Vaino?

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: I was a treasure hunter for so long, but, honestly, I'd been thinking about getting out of the game for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: There's this classic joke in that line of work: Where's the only place a 35-year-old treasure hunter gets called "young"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon has no idea...

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: At their funeral. Everyone's dabbing their eyes and saying, "Poor thing, they died so young..."

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: I'm 34 this year... At last month's gathering in The Flagship, everyone was speaking to me with this weird, respectful tone...

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: And it's not like I ever found any of Reed Miller's old treasure or anything. So when they started speaking to me all reverent-like, it felt off. Then I looked around and realized...

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Somehow, at some point, all the old dogs had disappeared and the room was filled with fresh-faced rookies. I suddenly realized I was the oldest one there!

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: There I was, in the middle of all that noise and cheer, and yet, this sudden chill gripped me tight. Like a voice whispering: "You're next." It was downright terrifying...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... if you look at it another way, you've actually been pretty lucky, right? After all, you've made it this far in one piece!

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Luck doesn't hang around forever. That's why I wanted out of the business. But... *sigh* it's been rough! If things keep going like this, I'll have to start taking on commissions again...

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: If it really comes to that, I'll make sure next year's funeral invite reads: "Look at me, no more rent, no more meals to worry about, and still so young, to boot! Jealous yet?"

choices.text: Would anyone show up...?

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: Eh? Who knows? Maybe a bunch of folks would show up just for the chance to punch me...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then they might as well not come at all! Why would you even think about your funeral!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's see if there's something we can do to help with your new career! You stopped us just now... Were you about to pitch us something?

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: I wanted to show you my training ground. Though, well, it's not serious training or anything. Just some light challenges, like shooting targets and dodging stuff.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, that sounds kinda fun!

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: Right? I figured kids would love this kind of thing! And there are tons of kids in Nasha Town!

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: My old colleagues should love it too. And there are so many Fatui stationed in Nod-Krai... It feels like it should be drawing in more people.

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: But it seems like no one's really interested... Maybe it's just not fun enough! Ugh, I just don't know what's wrong with my training ground!

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: Ugh, I just don't know what's wrong with my shooting range!

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: You two look exactly like the kind of guests I had in mind. If you'd be up for testing it out, and maybe giving me some feedback...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'd love to play— Uh, Paimon means help! We'd love to help!

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: Awesome! Then please follow the course I designed. Your first challenge is nearby. The second one's over that way. I marked the entrance to make it easy to spot.

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: The last challenge still needs a bit of work. I'll go fix it up now and wait for you there!

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: As for the rest... well, there's definitely some technique to hitting targets, but for your first time, just go with your instincts. Too much explanation will only trip you up.

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: Well then... have fun!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After briefly explaining the course, Vaino hurries off to finish setting up the final challenge.

choices.text: Let's hold off on the funeral talk for now...

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: I've just finished adjusting the third challenge based on Sisko's suggestions — it should be really fun!

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Congratulations! You're the first team to complete all the challenges!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, look! Even The Hollowhands came to cheer us on!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe they're waiting for a chance to steal the targets.

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: I've got to find them some comfier bedding material than those targets.

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Oh, right! I almost forgot your victory prize! This is some stuff I gathered back in the day. It's worth a decent amount!

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: But that was to Vaino, the treasure hunter. For Vaino, the training ground boss, it's not much use anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Please, take this as a token of my gratitude.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Luckily, we're not training ground bosses, so we'll gladly take this treasure off your hands!

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Come on now. My training ground will always be free for the two of you. Drop by anytime you like!

talks.objective: Go to the second challenge and start the challenge

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "This is the second challenge! From here on, the terrain starts to play a role. Oh, and in the second half, the targets will start moving, so be ready to shoot on the run!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Doesn't this spoil the most exciting part of the challenge?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thinks she understands the problem now... Nothing feels like a surprise — there's no suspense.

choices.text: Oh! Something just flashed by over there!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? P—Paimon didn't see anything... Wh—What was it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmph! {NICKNAME}, you're just messing with Paimon! Th—There's nothing there... r—right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This isn't the type of surprise Paimon wanted... You're a meanie! Just for that, y—you're leading the way from now on!

choices.text: Shh! Keep it down! Paimon, did you hear that...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: P—Paimon didn't hear anything at all... W—Was there a strange sound?!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What are we supposed to do next? Start counting? And close our eyes...?

choices.text: Start from one...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright! Let's close our eyes, and you can start counting.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: One...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Two...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Three...

choices.text: Four...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A—Are you counting slowly on purpose? It's kinda scary not being able to see anything...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright, I'll count faster.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: As the count goes on, you feel Paimon tugging at your clothes more tightly.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: As you enter the thirties, a soft rustling sound seems to come from somewhere nearby?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: "Fifty... Hmm? That was fifty, right?"\n"Were you about to doze off...? Come on, focus!"

choices.text: Four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Phew, that's much better... Paimon thought you were gonna drag it out forever...

choices.text: Seventy-seven!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You jumped straight to seventy-seven!? Do you really think that's going to work? Paimon'll be really happy if she doesn't have to close her eyes...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, look! Sniffer Moles!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So The Hollowhands are...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? The legendary, elusive rogues, The Hollowhands, are actually a bunch of Sniffer Moles? ...Paimon guesses it makes sense now she thinks about it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But why did you steal Vaino's targets?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: They don't seem to understand Paimon's question...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Seventy-seven?

response.speaker: Sniffer Mole Leader
response.text: Squee-squeak!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It answered you! So what's seventy-seven supposed to mean? Reed Miller's seventy-seven treasures? His seventy-seven loyal followers?

response.speaker: Sniffer Mole Leader
response.text: Squee-squeak! Squee-squeak!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't tell Paimon they think "seventy-seven" sounds like "squee-squeak"? Could that be it? ...Seven-squee-seven? Squeakenty-squeaken? Paimon's confused.

response.speaker: Sniffer Mole Leader
response.text: Squee-squeak! Squee-squeak!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So in the end, we still don't really know what it means...

choices.text: Seventy... eight!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #W—Waaah! {NICKNAME}, don't go summoning monsters — Huh? N—Nothing happened...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sheesh... Just close your eyes and count properly this time!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The fluttering hem in Paimon's grip trembles ever so slightly. Better get this over with... Seventy-five, seventy-six... seventy-seven!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Vaino, we've figured out what's wrong with the training ground!

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: That... um, that doesn't matter anymore. It's time I start getting my affairs in order...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: All my targets have vanished... again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe someone took them by accident?

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Nah, it's happened before. I got new materials, made new ones, and hid them somewhere no one would think to look.

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: But they've been taken again, which means someone's doing this on purpose!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon felt an eerie sensation in that cave just now... C—Could this have something to do with those sneaky thieves?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That was just me messing with you...

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Wait... So you sensed it too? That feeling of being watched. My instincts are never wrong. And anyway, my targets aren't worth that much. Who'd want to steal them?

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Even though I never took the really risky commissions when I was a treasure hunter, you don't spend that many years in a profession like mine without making a few enemies...

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: By taking the targets, they're sending me a sign: The next target is me.

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: It looks like I should've changed careers much sooner. I never thought I'd be sacrificing my life for a job like that at such a young age...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe you're overthinking it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Once we catch the thief, everything will become clear.

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: You two are... *sniff* so kind... If you have the time, please do attend my funeral!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, can we not keep bringing up your funeral!? There's still a chance we can fix this!

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Hmm, is that what they call the energy of babes...? Alright, I'll hang in there just a bit more.

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: At the very least, I won't give up until they actually come knocking. After all, I poured almost all my savings into this training ground.

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Hmm, I've dealt with Treasure Hoarders before, and in my experience, if you want to catch them, the best way is to bait a trap.

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: You can get target-making materials at the Krumkake Craftshop. I've been there a few times. Since they're after targets, let's use some to lure them out.

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll leave the thief to you two! As for me, I'll stay here and get started on fixing the third challenge they messed up.

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Whoa, that was quick! You've already finished the other challenges?

choices.text: Not just yet...

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: In that case, how about finishing off the first two challenges on the route I planned? It's easier to give feedback after you've seen the whole thing...

choices.text: Sorry, I got a little lost.

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: Guess the signs still need some work... Anyway, it's over that way. Please come back once you've cleared the previous challenges!

choices.text: I'm just looking around.

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: Oh, I see. In that case, I'll get back to setting up the third challenge.

talks.objective: Go to the Krumkake Craftshop and ask about the required materials

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hi there! Let Paimon introduce herself — Paimon is Paimon, and {M#he}{F#she}'s {NICKNAME}. We're here on Vaino's behalf to ask if you have any materials for making targets.

dialogues.speaker: Sisko
dialogues.text: Vaino...? Oh, you mean Uncle "Young"!

dialogues.speaker: Sisko
dialogues.text: He's run out of targets again? He just picked up a new batch the other day. Sounds like his training ground is a roaring success.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Actually, it's quite the opposite. Paimon thinks the only real customers are the two of us...

dialogues.speaker: Sisko
dialogues.text: Huh... Wh—What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The girl seems concerned, so you tell her about the missing targets.

dialogues.speaker: Sisko
dialogues.text: So things have been tough for him...? No wonder he looked so down. If you hadn't told me, we'd have had no idea...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who do you mean by "we"...?

dialogues.speaker: Sisko
dialogues.text: The kids around here. We all know Uncle "Young" needs target materials, so whenever we come across any, we collect them to sell to him.

choices.text: And then you go steal his targets afterward?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! So if Vaino loses his targets, he'll come back to buy more materials... and then you take apart the targets and sell them back to him!?

response.speaker: Sisko
response.text: W—Well... Y—Yes. B—But we never s—stole anything...

response.speaker: Sisko
response.text: Sorry... We really didn't know Uncle Young's business wasn't doing well. We figured, if he kept buying that many targets, he must be kinda rich...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He's used up almost all his savings just to keep the training ground afloat.

response.speaker: Sisko
response.text: I'm really sorry... If there's anything I can do to help...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You could start by telling me who the real thief is?

response.speaker: Sisko
response.text: Uh... well, I—I guess... It was The Hollowhands. But! They're not bad guys!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The Hollowhands... who are they?

response.speaker: Sisko
response.text: I can't tell you that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Vaino really needs our help right now! So no matter what, we have to find out who's been stealing those targets.

response.speaker: Sisko
response.text: Alright... but we don't really know who they are. They always vanish fast, and no one's ever seen them. I think they're like Reed Miller — a good kind of thief.

response.speaker: Sisko
response.text: We trade with them sometimes. No matter what we bring them, they always give us something really valuable in return.

choices.text: And that's how you've been getting the targets back?

response.speaker: Sisko
response.text: Yeah. It's not always just targets though. They sometimes give us Mora or other valuable parts. They've really helped us a lot.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Weird... What could The Hollowhands have against Vaino?

response.speaker: Sisko
response.text: We just thought... thieves have their reasons for thieving. So we figured Uncle Young must be loaded or something... S—Sorry!

response.speaker: Sisko
response.text: If you want to get his targets back, you could try trading them for some <color=#00E1FFFF>Old Portable Bearings</color>.

response.speaker: Sisko
response.text: I don't know if there's enough left, though... Uncle Young already bought some just a few days ago.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's not like we have any other ideas — let's give it a try!

choices.text: You've traded with them, but never seen them?

response.speaker: Sisko
response.text: They're very cautious! We just leave the stuff at the usual trading spot. We've never actually met them face-to-face.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aren't you even a little bit curious who The Hollowhands are?

response.speaker: Sisko
response.text: Of course we are. But they have their own rules. And if we want to trade with them, we have to respect those rules.

choices.text: Did you know the targets were being stolen?

response.speaker: Sisko
response.text: ...Yes.

response.speaker: Sisko
response.text: But we didn't steal them... We just, um, sold him the targets we got back, that's all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So it was just one set of targets, but he ended up paying for it over and over again! Poor Vaino...

talks.objective: Search higher up to collect Old Portable Bearings

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Those guys, honestly... It's just a job! Do they really have to hunt me down to the very end? I mean, life's full of way more interesting things...

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Like hanging out at the training ground and doing a bit of target shooting.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've got three of those Old Portable Bearings!

dialogues.speaker: Sisko
dialogues.text: Hmm, this should be enough. So now...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's time to trade, right? Where's the trading spot?

dialogues.speaker: Sisko
dialogues.text: Is... is it okay if I'm the one to make the trade?

dialogues.speaker: Sisko
dialogues.text: I promise, I'll tell them not to bother Uncle "Young" ever again!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We need to find out who they are.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Sisko, you trust The Hollowhands even though they won't show you their faces, right? Then surely you can trust {NICKNAME} and Paimon too!

dialogues.speaker: Sisko
dialogues.text: Okay, Paimon, you've got a point. I guess in a place like Nod-Krai, trusting others is never easy.

dialogues.speaker: Sisko
dialogues.text: To tell you the truth, I feel kinda scared every time I go to the cave to trade.

dialogues.speaker: Sisko
dialogues.text: It's pitch black in there, and you can hear this rustling sound. I always feel like there are a load of eyes staring at me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Vaino said he felt like he was being watched too! It has to be them!

dialogues.speaker: Sisko
dialogues.text: But they're not bad guys! Really!

dialogues.speaker: Sisko
dialogues.text: Every time we walk up to the little trade box, we leave our stuff inside, then close our eyes and count to seventy-seven.

dialogues.speaker: Sisko
dialogues.text: And then, "whoosh!", it's gone! Replaced by a gift.

dialogues.speaker: Sisko
dialogues.text: It's been like that every single time! They've never hurt any of us.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why seventy-seven?

dialogues.speaker: Sisko
dialogues.text: I heard it's because Reed Miller once stole seventy-seven treasures from the governor's palace! But Bozena says it's actually because he had seventy-seven loyal followers...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Or maybe it's because Reed Miller fell out of a window and did seventy-seven somersaults before hitting the ground...

dialogues.speaker: Sisko
dialogues.text: If that was the case, I don't think he'd be remembered as a legendary thief...

choices.text: I bet a monster shows up at seventy-eight and eats you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #W—What!? {NICKNAME}, you're just messing with Paimon again, aren't you?

response.speaker: Sisko
response.text: Anyway, everyone has a different story, but they all include the number seventy-seven. So who knows... maybe your version is the truth after all.

response.speaker: Sisko
response.text: Okay, good luck with the trade! And we'll tell everyone about Uncle Young, too! We'll also do our best to gather targets for him. N—No charge this time!

response.speaker: Sisko
response.text: But first, we'd better go say sorry...

choices.text: You'll probably get sleepy if you count any further...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Falling asleep in a spooky cave? You must really feel safe with Paimon around!

choices.text: We can just open our eyes at seventy-six!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, right! If we open our eyes early, we might just catch The Hollowhands in action!

response.speaker: Sisko
response.text: Huh? Are you sure you can do that? It feels like cheating if you don't follow the rules...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: W—Well, it's all dark in there anyway, so maybe no one will notice?

talks.objective: Go to The Hollowhands' trading spot

dialogues.speaker: Bozena
dialogues.text: Not a bad haul today, hehe!

choices.text: Hello, do you have any materials for making targets?

response.speaker: Bozena
response.text: You're buying this too? I don't think I've seen you before... Looks like this stuff's pretty popular!

response.speaker: Bozena
response.text: But I didn't get any today. Maybe try asking Sisko? She's right over there!

choices.text: Sorry to bother you.

response.speaker: Bozena
response.text: Bye!

talks.objective: Place the Old Portable Bearings at the trading spot
Follow the Sniffer Mole and collect the targets

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, that should be all the targets!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So they were using them as bedding all along? That's why they kept going after Vaino!

choices.text: I thought their burrows looked a lot cozier than those targets...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks so too! Those burrows looked super comfy. As for Vaino's targets... maybe they've got some special appeal only a Sniffer Mole would understand.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, even if we bring the targets back now, they'll probably just get stolen again in a few days... What should we do?

choices.text: Let's give them something better.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Great idea! We can leave a gift at the entrance to their "treasure chamber." Let's head back and see Vaino.

choices.text: Let's head back and talk to Vaino.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, Paimon's sure we can find something better than targets for their nest! Let's head back and figure it out together.

choices.text: It probably has something to do with the colors and patterns.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So they were using them for decoration? Maybe Sniffer Moles like that sort of style. Like Sisko said, "thieves have their reasons for thieving"!

talks.objective: Follow the Sniffer Mole and collect the targets

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Ah, you're back! I was just wondering if I should start getting my affairs... Umm, never mind. It's good to see you back in one piece!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You can rest easy, Vaino! Those sneaky target thieves are definitely not old enemies of yours!

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Really? Actually, that girl Sisko came to apologize just now. She said the ones behind it are called The Hollowhands. They sound like a pretty serious organization...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They're a bunch of Sniffer Moles.

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Sniffer Moles!? Come to think of it... Though I did feel like I was being watched, it never felt ominous, not like all the times I've sensed real danger.

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: But why would they want to steal my targets?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Vaino everything you uncovered.

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Hahaha, so that's what this was all about? I was this close to making arrangements for my funeral! Looks like I'll have to teach them a lesson!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: B—But they didn't mean anything by it...

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: No, no, that's not what I meant. If a few Old Portable Bearings were enough to trade back the targets, that means...

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: The exchange rate's totally in our favor!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhm? You mean...

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: If I show up with all sorts of gifts next time, I might get something amazing in return!

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Maybe I can make back all the losses from those stolen targets sooner than I thought.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Those losses... weren't actually caused by The Hollowhands.

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Yeah, I know, Sisko told me already. Still, I'm not going to ask those kids to repay anything.

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: She was chirping away just now, giving me all sorts of feedback on the training ground. And she even promised to bring her friends to come play.

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: Honestly, that's worth more to me than any amount of Mora.

choices.text: So we're back to exchange rates again, huh?

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: Thanks a lot. I think I've figured out how to make this place more fun. I just hope more folks will want to stop by!

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: Wanna give it a shot? The final challenge! I promise it's way more fun than the first two!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's give it a go!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Like we'd ever say no to something fun!

choices.text: Textbook treasure hunter's instincts.

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: "Former" treasure hunter.

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: You've been a big help! I'll keep what you and little Sisko said in mind. Here's hoping more and more folks come by!

dialogues.speaker: Lalli
dialogues.text: Better keep looking. This probably isn't enough to beat Bozena.

choices.text: Hello, do you have any materials for making targets?

response.speaker: Lalli
response.text: Nope, I sold all of mine a few days ago. Try asking Sisko — she might still have some.

choices.text: Sorry to bother you.

response.speaker: Lalli
response.text: It's okay. Hope you find what you need.

dialogues.speaker: Sisko
dialogues.text: Did you find any? Hmm... This might not be enough. Try looking for a few more.
